page_intro: COSI Lab studies hip and knee surgery using clinical data, imaging, biomechanical modeling, and surgical robotics. We welcome students, orthopaedic trainees, and researchers interested in this work.
apply_text: Review our current research, then use the application form to tell us about your background and the work you are interested in.
level1_desc: Students interested in clinical or computational orthopaedic research.
level2_desc: Students interested in research on hip and knee surgery, including clinical outcomes and surgical technology.
level3_desc: Trainees with clinical research questions in outcomes, biomechanics, or surgical robotics.
level4_desc: Researchers in machine learning, biomechanics, statistics, and related fields.
